source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of 'Access Control' (PDF 20): the same text in simple Roman Urdu with glossed hard words, a self-check and a recap.

blocks.text: Access control decide karta (tay karta) hai ke network kaun istemal kar sakta hai. Yeh sirf authorized (ijazat wale) users ko andar aane deta hai. Usernames aur passwords aam access controls hain. Permissions (ijazatein) limit karti (had muqarrar karti) hain ke users kya kar sakte hain. Access control ahem resources (cheezon, jaise files aur printers) ko bachata hai. Yeh network ka istemal manage karne (sambhalne) mein madad deta hai.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: School ke computer system mein student apne marks dekh sakta hai magar badal nahi sakta, jabke teacher badal sakta hai. Yeh permissions hain.

blocks.prompt: Access control ke do aam tareeqe batayein.
blocks.explanation: Username aur password (kaun andar aaye) aur permissions (andar aa kar kya kar sake).

items: Access control: kaun network use kare (username/password) aur kya kare (permissions); ahem resources ki hifazat.
